C9000223.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 223 (Random-cluster interfaces: critical, disordered, thermal, and natural-time scaling.; papers: Square-lattice FK interfaces and nested loops for 1 <= q < 4; Self-dual random-cluster interfaces below one; Quenched SLE Universality for Weakly Disordered FK–Ising Interfaces; Thermal FK–Ising interfaces and massive SLE; Natural Occupation Measures for Critical Square-Lattice FK Interfaces; Conformal Limits of Critical Square-Lattice Random-Cluster Interfaces; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

PC_CORE.statement: Universal positive site pressure, connected support, convergence beyond the unit polydisk and the incident/cofacial Rayleigh consequence, with the finite hypotheses of 01-pressure.tex unchanged.

PC_PRESSURE.statement: All nonzero site multiindices, including repeated labels, have nonnegative pressure coefficients; positive coefficients have connected support and the series converges beyond the unit polydisk.

PC_SQUAREFREE.statement: The site polynomial has exactly the squarefree moments W(T) in pressure:squarefree after the incident gamma rescaling.

PC_FIXED_UNION.statement: The complete fixed-ordinary-union sum, with repeated labels allowed, is v_D times the product of Z(D0;-u,1+v) over ordinary components.

PC_NEGATIVE_PARTITION.statement: Z(G;-u,w)<0 for every nonempty connected finite multigraph, 0<u<1 and all w_e>=1.

PC_POLYMER.statement: The actual formal negative logarithm of every finite hard-core polymer partition series with nonnegative zero-constant polynomial-coefficient activities is coefficientwise nonnegative, for all grading degrees and all repeated site multiindices. Lean certifies this generic theorem; independent statement-fidelity review remains.

PC_POLYMER_REDUCTION.statement: The finite FK site polynomial is exactly the hard-core partition polynomial on disjoint vertex subsets with connected-ordinary-union amplitudes lambda(S)>=0. Grading each activity by support size transfers every site coefficient from the generic formal theorem.

PC_CONNECTED_SUPPORT.statement: A pressure coefficient with disconnected site support is zero: setting all other variables to zero makes the squarefree polynomial factor over the induced support components.

PC_HARD_SIGN.statement: The connected hard-edge alternating sum is zero or has sign (-1)^(b-1), with cancellation for an internal hard edge.

PC_CUMULANT.statement: The labeled moment-cumulant identity equals the connected A-union-B-union-L structure sum, including all repeated types.

PC_CONVERGENCE.statement: Nonnegative formal coefficients and positivity of F_H on the real unit cube give absolute convergence in a polydisk of radius strictly greater than one.

PC_HUB.statement: The hub partition identity holds for all finite nonnegative hub odds, including parallel links at a site.

PC_RAYLEIGH.statement: Distinct incident FK edges have nonpositive opening covariance; plane duality gives the cofacial statement, and deletion/contraction minors preserve it.

PC_FINITE_DIAGNOSTIC.statement: Exact diagnostics pass 80 graph/parameter cases, 2700 degree-at-most-four coefficients, 11612 ordinary unions and 920 incident covariance checks. This is diagnostic evidence only.
